profile.headline: Building the future
profile.summary:
Hello!

My journey has always been driven by a deep-seated passion for entrepreneurship and innovation. From my early days, I've been captivated by the magic that lies in transforming complex ideas into tangible realities. This fascination led me to pursue engineering studies, where I not only sharpened my problem-solving skills, but also learned how to bring my innovative ideas to life.

My college years were instrumental in shaping my career. I spearheaded the creation of the FAMU Innovation Center, fostered a student-run VC group, and even advocated for NASA STEM education on Capitol Hill. These experiences imbued in me a profound understanding of leadership, collaboration, and innovation.

Post-college, I delved into the dynamic world of financial technology at Ally Financial. As an integral part of their Innovation Labs, I've been at the forefront of researching and implementing cutting-edge technologies. From creating POCs for NFTs and StableCoins to deploying applications on the cloud with AWS and Terraform, my journey has been nothing short of a continuous tech adventure. I've also had the unique opportunity to explore emerging trends related to Metaverse and blockchain.

Parallel to my work at Ally, I've held key roles in various start-ups, including co-founding Virtual Lens and Ktel Mining. These ventures have further honed my entrepreneurial skills and cemented my commitment to finding solutions to everyday problems.

Despite my busy schedule, I never miss an opportunity to participate in hackathons and entrepreneurial pitch competitions. To date, I've attended over 30 such events across the country, each one providing a unique learning experience and challenging me to push my boundaries.

When I'm not immersed in my work, I love to tinker with various technologies that I believe can transform our world. I'm always open to discussing new ideas, so feel free to reach out!

Fun Fact: I'm an INTJ on the Myers-Briggs scale, which means I'm a natural planner and strategic thinker.

Crypto Dev Wallet: dev.keysmit.eth

Thanks for stopping by!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As an Application Engineer at Vanguard, I am immersed in leveraging progressive technology to foster innovation and enhance the functionality of our applications. Below are some pivotal aspects of my role:

Application Development and Maintenance:

- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality applications employing a blend of technologies such as JavaScript, AngularJS, and TypeScript.
- Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement within the team.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues promptly.


Cloud Integration and Deployment:

- Utilize Amazon Web Services (AWS) to architect scalable, secure, and robust cloud-based solutions.
- Facilitate the seamless deployment and integration of applications in cloud environments, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.


Testing and Quality Assurance:

- Employ Jest for comprehensive testing to identify bugs and ensure the delivery of high-quality software.
- Define and implement testing strategies within the team to ensure the robustness and stability of applications.


Technical Leadership:

- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers, aiding in their professional development.
- Stay abreast of the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure that Vanguard remains at the forefront of technological innovation.


Project Management:

- Work closely with project managers to ensure timely delivery of projects within scope and budget.
- Participate in agile development cycles, contributing to sprint planning, and retrospective meetings to continually refine our development processes.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AngularJS · JavaScript · Jest

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Ktel Mining is at the intersection of blockchain technology and community-driven growth. We partner with small businesses to leverage the expansive potential of the Helium blockchain. By installing specialized devices in our host locations, we amplify the reach of a decentralized wireless network, paving the way for a robust Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem.

Our hosts, the heartbeat of our operations, benefit from a new revenue stream through the mining of Helium tokens (HNT). This innovative model not only extends network coverage but also fortifies local businesses, creating a win-win for all.

positions.title: Associate - Innovation & Emerging Technologies
positions.description:
At Ally Technology Labs, my role embodied a continual hackathon spirit, fostering innovation. I led rigorous research on nascent technologies, and formulated Proofs of Concept (POCs) to demonstrate their potential advantages to directors and executives. Noteworthy projects and responsibilities include:


Research and POCs:

- Explored blockchain technology, leading to the creation of NFT domain names and cryptocurrency/StableCoin POCs.
- Delved into the Metaverse using Oculus Quest to gauge emerging trends.


Web Development:

- Crafted a dynamic React website to exhibit in-house projects.
- Developed a PWA via Ionic framework to aid employees in navigating office spaces.


Deployment:

- Utilized Terraform and AWS for deploying frontend applications to the cloud.


Authentication:

- Integrated Okta for enterprise-level authentication of applications.


Collaboration:

- Co-created a "Super App" with a team of skilled developers, enhancing our digital offerings.


Documentation:

- Authored comprehensive guides on blockchain and Metaverse applications.


Development Areas: 

Cloud Technologies, Blockchain, Low-Code/No-Code, L2 Ethereum Platforms, Smart Contracts, PWAs.


Skills: 

Low-Code Development, React, AWS, Terraform, Ionic, Okta, Blockchain Technologies, Metaverse Research, NFT Creation.


This tenure at Ally significantly honed my technical acumen, while enabling me to contribute to the forward-thinking technological agenda of the organization.

honors.title: ACC InVenture Competition (Represented FAMU-FSU College of Engineering)
honors.description:
Our senior design team, which consisted of students from both FAMU and FSU, were selected to represent FSU in a national collegiate competition. 

The Atlantic Coast Conference InVenture Prize is a collaborative effort by institutional leadership from the Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC). It represents an opportunity to stimulate undergraduate entrepreneurial activity and increase student-faculty engagement, to celebrate and highlight the exceptional creativity and ingenuity of our students, and to inspire a greater sense of camaraderie across the conference. 

The ACC InVenture Prize is an innovation competition in which teams of undergraduates representing each ACC university pitch their inventions or businesses before a live audience and a panel of judges. Teams will compete for $30,000 in prizes and a chance to be the next ACC InVenture Prize winner. Fifteen university teams will pitch during the preliminary round on Tuesday, April 14, but only five finalists will be chosen to advance to the final round on Wednesday, April 15. The final round will be broadcast live on PBS and streamed online.
honors.issuer: Issued by Florida State University  · Mar 2020

honors.title: Moguls in the Making - 1st Place
honors.description:
The Thurgood Marshall College Fund’s (TMCF) Innovation and Entrepreneurship (I&E) Program has teamed up with Ally Financial and the Sean Anderson Foundation to find the best and brightest entrepreneurial minds among publicly-supported Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs). We’re looking for the greatest young minds, who think critically, creatively, and are passionate about solving problems. TMCF will select ten publicly-supported HBCUs to participate in this competition. Of the ten schools selected to compete, five students from each school will make up their team and represent their institution. This two and a half day business competition will be both challenging and rewarding to you! Students will be tasked with developing solutions to economic problems facing various industries, and then pitch their ideas to a panel of expert judges comprised of entrepreneurs, small business owners, executives, venture capitalists, and other investors. 

Produced AI CFO platform that used small business owners’ sales data and location to optimize financial decisions

Conducted weekly ideation sessions to prepare business students for competition

Presented our solution to Sean Anderson (BigSean) and Ally Financial C-Suite executives
honors.issuer: Issued by Thurgood Marshall College Fund · Apr 2019

projects.title: Captionly
projects.description:
I'm thrilled to present Captionly.me, a groundbreaking website that leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence to generate engaging Instagram captions.

This innovative platform is designed to transform the way we create content for social media. Simply upload an image, and Captionly's advanced AI system will craft a unique, contextually relevant caption for your Instagram post.

But that's not all! We've recently rolled out some exciting updates to enhance your experience. Along with our new domain name, we've improved the user interface to make it more intuitive and user-friendly.

The core of Captionly lies in its sophisticated AI technology. By harnessing the capabilities of OpenAI's GPT-3, Captionly ensures that you always have the perfect words to accompany your Instagram images.

Feel free to explore the platform and revolutionize your social media content creation process. Happy captioning!

Responsibilities: 
- Work with university faculty in grant writing . 
- Creating valuable partnerships within the university and community

- Collecting research on equipment to accomplish objectives. 
- Working with a team of students to create effective UX of facility.
